Initial release of openapi-docs-generator

- Provides practical help for generating, improving, and validating OpenAPI/Swagger documentation for REST APIs.
- Offers a structured workflow emphasizing actionable outputs, checklists, and local-hardware-friendly solutions.
- Tailors responses based on user requirements, ensuring clarity and validation steps.
- Triggers on keywords related to API documentation and developer experience.
- Includes clear validation and next-step guidance for users.
